cells.gaps: No source dated in the last three years shows an appointed authority registering organisations, taking breach reports, issuing guidance or inspecting; a March 2026 article says the Data Protection Commission is not established (LSO-008). The same article says Lesotho has signed but not ratified the Malabo Convention (LSO-007), against the African Union list recording ratification on 5 February 2025 (LSO-004).
cells.note: The law is in force and the African Union depositary list records ratification, so the cell holds stage 3; the article contradicting it gives no date for its claim. No authority is appointed, so stage 4 is not reached.
